<article class="bms-glossary-term-card" id="term-suicide-play">
<p class="bms-glossary-term-name">Suicide Play</p>
<p class="bms-glossary-aliases"><strong>Also called:</strong> <span id="alias-hara-kiri-play">Hara-Kiri Play</span>, <span id="alias-kamikaze-play">Kamikaze Play</span></p>
<p class="bms-glossary-definition">Suicide Play means to leave a checker deliberately available to be hit so it can recirculate and improve timing or defense. Knowing this term makes it easier to follow backgammon lessons and analysis.</p>
<p class="bms-glossary-category"><strong>Glossary category:</strong> <a href="/learn/glossary/?category=checker%20play%20and%20tactics#term-suicide-play">Checker Play and Tactics</a></p>
<p class="bms-glossary-usage-note"><strong>Usage note:</strong> Historical jargon. Prefer the neutral term recirculation play in teaching copy.</p>
<p class="bms-glossary-usage-note"><strong>Hara-Kiri Play:</strong> Historical jargon. Prefer the neutral term recirculation play in teaching copy.</p>
<p class="bms-glossary-usage-note"><strong>Kamikaze Play:</strong> Historical jargon. Prefer the neutral term recirculation play in teaching copy.</p>
